# Isaiah Chapter 7 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**7:14** Therefore the-Lord himself will-give yitten to-you a-sign ot: Behold, the-young-woman ha-almah is pregnant harah and-bearing veyoledet a-son ben, and-she-will-call veqarat his-name Immanu-El God-With-Us.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 7 — "The Sign of Immanuel" — part of First Isaiah (chs.1-39), rooted in the 8th-century BCE Assyrian crisis. The chapter contributes to Isaiah's overarching vision: YHWH as the Holy One of Israel who judges his people but promises ultimate restoration.

---
